threads.body: [General] This new behavior contradicts the Apache DBCP module documentation: `instrumentation/apache-dbcp-2.0/metadata.yaml:15-16` and the generated `javaagent/README.md:16-17` still state that late MBean registration switches to the `ObjectName`-based name. Update the metadata to say the first registered metric name is retained, then regenerate the README so users are not told the opposite behavior.
